justification: Two losses in a row and I shake the family up, that's the code, but there's nothin' in the receiver room to shake — Wilson's on IR, Pittman's on IR, that's not a roster decision, that's an obituary wearing a jersey, and Boutte's the only warm body left so he plays. I did my shakin' in the backfield instead: Breece Hall's Questionable and I usually give a hurt guy extra respect, but a man projected at zero might not even suit up, and after gettin' buried 109 to 21 last week I'm not gambling the flex on a maybe — Kamara's healthy, he eats. LaPorta's rested long enough on my bench, numbers don't lie and he's walkin' back into the tight end chair over Ferguson, no hard feelings, business is business. Murray stays at quarterback over Nix — I don't churn my guy for two and a half points on somebody else's spreadsheet, that's panic, and panic's how you lose a family. Everybody else earned their chair Sunday morning and nobody's losing it over a bad month.
